title: Merge-lane classifier and exact-head pinning
problem: Autonomous merges must never merge unverified or changed heads, and must not decide governance/security/contract changes.

options.summary: SAFE-AUTO is a policy result requiring every gate explicitly clear; unknown flags route to MANAGER; failed/unanchored checks route to HOLD; authorization is a 900s lease pinned to repo/PR/base/head

rationale: A head change moves READY to HOLD, resets checks and revokes the authorization lease. SAFE-AUTO requires the SIMPLE rollback class with verified rollback, no manager-lane flags and no CONTRACT_LOCK/GOVERNANCE_LOCK reservation. IRREVERSIBLE merges always need a HUMAN approval bound to the exact item. MERGED is not COMPLETE: completion requires fresh-main verification evidence at MAIN_VERIFIED trust or higher.
